We had an unforgettable trip.  Kapalai is built on a sandbank in the middle of the Celebes Sea; it is 40 minutes by speedboat from Semporna town jetty.  Safety is ensured by 24/7 armed Malaysian military presence.  ||On arrival we were warmly greeted by smiling staff with cool towels and drinks; lunch was served shortly after in the beautiful airy dining area.  There were beautiful flowers and plants along the walkways, thanks to the hard work of the gardeners.||Our overwater villa was clean and spacious with a deck.  It was well appointed, with a shower, separate bath, and all the mod cons -  airconditioning, fans, a fridge, hot water, and wifi.  It did become quite hot in the afternoon despite the airconditioning, and we found it much cooler in the open-air garden lounge.  We heard loud croaks every night in our villa which turned out to be a night heron which had taken up residence on the stilts beneath our villa.  ||The sunset bar is highly recommended, as is the walkway to the lookout point where you can enjoy views of the lovely sunset. There is also a sunrise lookout tower on the opposite end of the resort.  ||The room rate included full board, and the buffet meals did not disappoint.  The variety and quality of food were impressive!  We were pleasantly surprised by a private dinner on our first night (shoutout to Downbelow Marine & Wildlife Adventures, our tour agent, for organizing this) - the dishes were excellent and our table was right next to the water.||The best was yet to come..... early the next morning we couldn't believe our eyes when we saw dozens of green sea turtles swimming past our villa to the open sea, coming up every now and then to take a breath!  This was an incredibly magical experience!  Kapalai has sea grass, and we could sometimes spot these gentle giant creatures grazing in the water beside the walkways.||Snorkelling in the Dive Centre was another highlight with the gorgeous coral and fish! The designated area was small but as there were only 4-5 of us it was fine. ||We walked most of the time from our villa to the common areas but when it was hot we opted for the buggy. 入住 Sipadan Kapalai Dive Resort 之後，最大感覺係「真正離開咗日常生活」。整個度假村建喺海上，四面環海，環境非常安靜，日出同日落都好靚，夜晚只聽到海聲，對放鬆心情同減壓好有幫助。

潛水係最大亮點。Kapalai 附近潛點微距生物非常多，潛導專業又有耐性，會細心帶你睇生物，就算唔係資深潛水員都覺得安心同享受。整體安排唔趕，節奏好舒服。

房間係水上屋，唔算豪華但乾淨企理，冷氣夠、床好瞓。WiFi 唔太穩定，但反而令人放低手機，專心休息。

餐飲選擇唔算多，但食物新鮮，潛水完食會特別滿足。
整體嚟講，呢度唔適合想玩樂或夜生活嘅人，但如果你係為潛水同真正放鬆而嚟，Kapalai 係一個好值得體驗嘅地方。

Staying at Sipadan Kapalai Dive Resort truly felt like disconnecting from everyday life. The resort is built over the sea, surrounded by water in every direction, with a very peaceful atmosphere. Sunrises and sunsets are beautiful, and at night you only hear the sound of the ocean — perfect for relaxing and relieving stress.

Diving is definitely the highlight. The nearby dive sites around Kapalai are rich in macro marine life, and the dive guides are professional and patient, always taking time to point out small creatures. Even for non-expert divers, the experience feels safe and enjoyable. The schedule is well-paced and not rushed.

The water villas are simple but comfortable, clean, with good air conditioning and comfortable beds. WiFi is limited, but that actually helps you unplug and fully relax.

Food options are not extensive, but meals are fresh and satisfying, especially after diving.
Overall, this is not a resort for nightlife or entertainment, but if you come for diving and true relaxation, Sipadan Kapalai is absolutely worth it.

🌴 The Taaras Beach & Spa Resort – A Dream Week in a Corner of Paradise 🌊✨

There are places you visit... and then there are places that stay with you. The Taaras is not just a resort – it’s an experience that wraps you in beauty and serenity.

We spent a dream week filled with peaceful moments, postcard-perfect views, and pure wonder.

From the moment we arrived, the welcome was warm and genuine. Our garden view suite, while spacious, showed a few signs of wear… but the management, incredibly kind, surprised us with a complimentary upgrade to a sea view suite. What a gift! 🌊 Opening the door and finding ourselves right on the beach, lulled by the sound of the waves, was priceless.

Nature is the true star here. Between playful monkeys, monitor lizards, and lush vegetation, you feel like you're in another world. And during snorkeling trips, we had the unforgettable chance to swim alongside sea turtles and small reef sharks – moments of magic that words can’t quite capture.

🏖️ The private beach is a tropical dream: powdery white sand, crystal-clear water, and absolute tranquility.

🍽️ The food? Delicious. Generous breakfasts, well-prepared local and international dishes, always-fresh tropical fruit – all enjoyed with a breathtaking ocean view.

And the staff… always attentive, smiling, never intrusive. You feel genuinely welcomed, heard, and cared for.

My heartfelt advice: if you're looking for a true escape – a place to slow down, breathe, and fill your soul with beauty – this is it. One week isn’t enough to stop dreaming about it.

价格与服务不匹配，不建议入住
我们于2025年7月25日（星期五）上午11:45抵达大停泊岛，但并无酒店员工迎接或指引。我们自行拖行李前往接待处后才得知酒店其实有行李运送服务，但并未在码头提供协助，实在不合理。

办理入住后被告知下午三点才能拿房，而我们的三天两夜浮潜配套第一场活动是在当天下午三点。多数酒店通常会弹性安排提前入住以配合行程，但这家酒店没有任何协调，只让我们寄存贵重物品。

浮潜结束后回到酒店，却发现行李被随意放在房门口。询问之下，工作人员称“不能随意进房”，但行李却能丢在无人看管的走廊两小时，无闭路电视保障，安全隐患极大。

入住后还发现冰箱里有半瓶喝过的水，明显房间未彻底清洁。而第二天虽然我们挂了“请勿打扰”牌子，外出浮潜回来后却发现有人进入更换了毛巾和水，前后政策矛盾。

泳池也未清洁彻底，底部明显布满污垢，令人却步。此外，酒店物价离谱，一罐普通汽水竟要RM9，远高于一般岛上酒店。

尽管大停泊岛本身风景迷人，我未来可能还会再来，但绝不会再入住这家酒店，服务水平与价格严重不符。

The price does not match the service, not recommended
We arrived at Perhentian Besar Island at 11:45 AM on July 25, 2025, but no hotel staff were present to greet or assist us. We had to carry our luggage ourselves to reception, only to find out later that luggage service was supposed to be provided—why wasn’t anyone at the jetty?

After checking in, we were told we could only access our room at 3 PM, even though our snorkeling package likely had the first session at 2 PM. Other hotels typically allow early check-in for such cases, but no flexibility was offered here.

After snorkeling (3–5 PM), we returned to find our bags left outside the room. Staff claimed they couldn’t enter rooms—but then why leave bags unattended for hours in a public hallway with no CCTV?

In our room, we found a half-drunk water bottle in the fridge—clear sign of poor housekeeping. On day two, although we had a “Do Not Disturb” sign up, someone entered to change towels and water, contradicting their earlier “no entry” policy.

The swimming pool was dirty, with grime covering much of the floor, making it uninviting. Prices were also unreasonable—RM9 for a basic soda, far above island norms.

While Perhentian Island itself is beautiful, I will not stay at this hotel again. Its service quality does not match its pricing.
